design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it focuses on log-file data and binary classification outcomes.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The matching, text-readable full PDF does not report use or explicit non-use of sampling weights; full-text search found no weight terminology. Original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual student-level data without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Matching Pejić & Molcer (2021) PDF describes downsampling for class balance, but does not report train/test splitting, cross-validation, an external test sample, or another validation design. Downsampling is preprocessing, not validation.
